items.title: Citizen is becoming a public developer product
items.summary: The next release line is focused on making Citizen easy to install, professional to use, and continuously synchronizable.
items.body: This page intentionally distinguishes shipped behavior from work in development and future vision. Citizen's operational state remains evidence-first and independent of the developer checkout.

items.title: Citizen survives a real host reboot
items.summary: LOCAL-004 independently proved service restart, identity persistence, evidence persistence, Node recovery and authority-boundary behavior.
items.body: The validated Citizen retained its identity and evidence across a real host reboot and re-established its Node connection automatically.

items.title: From local Citizen to a governed asset organism
items.summary: Future releases will expand the Citizen while preserving the core boundary: local execution and evidence, remote governance.
items.body: The future direction includes richer asset visibility, public demonstrations, educational material and a broader governed asset model.
